newsitem.title: FRANCE: Composer chokes by fine for eating hamburger.
newsitem.headline: Composer chokes by fine for eating hamburger.

text.p: A 25-year-old French composer is having trouble digesting the results of eating a hamburger in his car -- a 230-franc ($45) fine levelled by two highway policemen.

Antoine Deneuveille told reporters near the northern French city of Lille that the citation accompanying the fine read: "Driver not in constant position to easily and quickly carry out necessary manoeuvres behind wheel. Was eating sandwich."
Deneuveille said the policemen saw him take a bite from the hamburger while briefly halted at a stop sign at a crossroads. He said the car was not moving.

French law requires drivers to keep full control of their cars at all times but motorists routinely use car telephones when driving without being stopped by police. The bitter composer said he would write a pop song about the incident.
